# The Python API {#sec-pyapi}

Every public class, function and method of the package `biyos`, generated from its docstrings and its annotations. The package ships its annotations, so an editor or a type checker reads the same types. @sec-python describes the package as a whole, and the C API of @sec-capi gives the rules each method follows.
